retention windows for logs and SSO artifacts
summary: Weekly ops sync focused on finalizing invoice reconciliation for the upcoming audit, collecting evidence artifacts (KMS rotation notes, SSO logs, PO receipts), and aligning owners and deadlines. Decided to produce a single evidence bundle and assign reviewers and export formats.
next_steps: Ava to assemble evidence bundle link and share by 2027-09-17
Devon to finish invoice tagging and upload CSV by 2027-09-16
Riley to export SSO audit logs and KMS key rotation proof by 2027-09-18
Sam to confirm outstanding PO numbers and escalate missing receipts by 2027-09-20
action_items: Ava Martinez: Create evidence bundle (zip + index.md) and post to shared drive - due 2027-09-17
Devon Chen: Reconcile August invoices, tag Hosted vs Dedicated, attach receipts - due 2027-09-16
Riley Patel: Export Okta SAML login history and HSM/KMS rotation logs, annotate anomalies - due 2027-09-18
Sam Ortega: Chase procurement for three missing POs (PO-3342, PO-3410, PO-3456) and upload PDFs - due 2027-09-20

transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2027-09-14
Start: 15:00 UTC
Duration: 58 minutes
Attendees: Ava (IT Lead), Devon (Finance), Riley (Security), Sam (Procurement), Maya (Legal), Noah (Platform Ops)

[00:00] Ava: alright everyone's on, uh, good afternoon team, thanks for joining the invoice and audit evidence sync. we'll run about 45ish but we have 58 on the calendar so uh plenty of time if we need it.
[00:32] Devon: hi all, Devon here. quick heads up I pulled the August invoicing dump, there's a couple of mismatches on the dedicated pools charges that I'm still tracking. some line items are labeled "dedicated-resv" and others just "dedicated" so need to normalize.
[01:05] Riley: yes i saw that too, the billing feed from the infra side changed a bit when we rolled the new routing in July. the label map wasn't updated in the cost pipeline.
[01:22] Sam: hey, Sam from procurement — i've got three POs outstanding, i'll list them later. also need to confirm whether any of those map to third-party hardware invoices.
[01:40] Maya: Maya here, legal — we only need the high level receipts and the chain of custody for any contract changes. redactions are fine but please flag anything with customer-identifiable info.
[02:05] Noah: quick note from platform, some of the older hosted credits were applied weirdly across two accounts, that could be creating the mismatch Devon mentioned.
[02:30] Ava: ok let's structure this: 1) invoices reconciliation owner (Devon), 2) evidence artifacts (Ava + Riley), 3) procurement receipts (Sam), 4) legal review (Maya). timeline—audit folder needs to be deliverable by end of next week.
[03:02] Devon: sounds good. i already started a CSV, i'll push draft to the shared drive and add a tag column. can we agree on tag values? Hosted / Dedicated / Marketplace?
[03:25] Riley: use Hosted, Dedicated, ThirdParty as the three we need. also add a "quantization" column? kidding. sometimes the model charges are in marketplace lines so ThirdParty captures marketplace.
[03:40] Sam: ThirdParty is fine. i'll also add PO number field so we can match receipts.
[04:05] Ava: on evidence artifacts—Riley you mentioned KMS rotation proof last week. we need an export that shows key id, rot date, who triggered rotation and a signature or ticket. what format can you pull?
[04:28] Riley: i can export rotation events from the HSM logs and KMS audit trail. Okta and KMS are separate so i need to correlate with the change ticket. i'll produce a PDF log and a CSV extract. pro tip: sometimes the KMS logs are large and the transcript gets cut — transcription note — in the audit we prefer a CSV plus a short digest doc.
[04:55] Devon: perfect. and on SSO logs, do we need the whole login history or just admin-level activity?
[05:10] Maya: legal prefers admin activity plus any privilege escalations in the period. default retention is 1 year but for audit evidence we can include the last 90 days export.
[05:32] Noah: reminding that retention policy is on the infra wiki: retention.svc/ops — there may be redaction steps for IP addresses.
[05:50] Ava: noted. Riley, can you also extract Okta SAML assertion logs for admin sessions from 2027-06-01 to 2027-09-14?
[06:12] Riley: yes i can do that. might be heavy; i'll compress and attach link.
[06:30] [Speaker 1]: um, quick interruption — is the evidence bundle going to live in drive or in the compliance bucket?
[06:40] Ava: good question. i'd prefer the compliance S3 bucket with presigned links because legal can't always access internal drive. i'll create an index.md in the bucket that points to each artifact and add presigned urls that expire in 30 days; then we'll export a static zip for auditors.
[07:05] Devon: can you meta-tag the S3 objects with fiscal quarter and PO number? makes reconciliation script easier.
[07:22] Ava: yep tagging with fiscal_q and po_number will be part of the upload step.
[07:40] Sam: procurement update—PO-3342 is missing vendor receipt, vendor says they sent to billing@redwood but it didn't land in our finance mailbox; i've opened a ticket with the vendor and cc'd accounts-payable.
[08:02] Maya: when you get that, please note if the vendor sent any PII — otherwise we'll redact.
[08:18] Devon: small data point — there's a $12k hardware invoice that was misattributed to hosting; should be ThirdParty. i have a note in the CSV.
[08:35] Ava: ok add that line with comment.
[08:48] Riley: also saw one rotation event that occurred outside working hours — likely automated, but it lacks the corresponding change ticket number in the log. i will try to backfill by correlating with the orchestration job logs.
[09:12] Noah: that orchestration job is job-rot-3, the cron that runs nightly — maybe the operator override was applied by ops-runner. i'll search.
[09:32] Ava: please add the orchestration job id to the evidence so it's traceable.
[09:45] Devon: question on the audit format: do auditors prefer a narrated index or raw files?
[10:00] Maya: generally both. index with bullets + raw files. index should state scope, timeframe, contact person, and redaction notes.
[10:20] Ava: i'll draft index.md template and share.
[10:35] [00:10:35] Devon: oh and one more: we have two months left on an annual support contract for dedicated pool RD-2 — want to confirm if that should roll into next fiscal or be expensed now.
[10:55] Riley: that's policy — finance calls it prepayment amortization. Devon, you'll need to show the contract and the invoice date.
[11:10] Devon: ok i'll attach contract excerpt and amortization schedule.
[11:28] Sam: procurement can confirm PO coding for amortization.
[11:42] Ava: good. moving to next topic—evidence chain of custody. we need to show who assembled the evidence bundle and who had write access during packaging. how are we handling write-locks?
[12:00] Riley: i'll create a temporary S3 prefix with restricted ACLs and enable object-lock for the zip. ACL will allow only Ava, Riley, and Devon to write until sign-off, then we flip perms.
[12:22] Noah: make sure to set bucket versioning, that'll help show historical changes.
[12:35] Ava: yes versioning on. i'll record the ACL changes in the index.md with timestamps.
[12:50] Devon: tiny transcription hiccup earlier—i think one of the invoice lines read "redwood-dedi-01" but might be "redwood-delta-01" in the billing feed. i've made a note to fuzzy match.
[13:05] Riley: fuzz matching is fine for triage but auditors will want exact matches for PO numbers. keep the fuzzy only for internal mapping.
[13:25] Maya: legal also wants a short statement on data retention policy applied to this evidence: whether it will be retained beyond the standard 12 months for audit purposes.
[13:40] Ava: decision: retain the evidence bundle for 18 months in the compliance bucket. Maya, are we good with that?
[13:52] Maya: yes that is acceptable from legal. please include the retention rationale in index.md.
[14:05] Devon: moving to costs—i ran a pivot by project and environment, dedicated pools are 42% of the GPU spend for August, hosted is 38, marketplace/third-party 20. we should ensure that committed usage is being fully utilized.
[14:25] Noah: is that net of credits?
[14:30] Devon: net of credits yes, I excluded promo credits.
[14:40] Riley: any chance that autoscaler misconfiguration led to overrun? we had an autoscale policy change mid-August.
[14:52] Ava: operations changed target concurrency from 18 to 22 for RD-2; that could be it. Noah, can you produce a chart of concurrency vs cost?
[15:00] Noah: yes, i can run the cost telemetry and output a grafana snapshot.
[15:10] [00:15:10] Devon: back on procurement — Sam, what's the ETA on the vendor receipts?
[15:20] Sam: replied to vendor, vendor acknowledged; hoping to have PDFs by EOD Monday. if not i'll escalate.
[15:30] Ava: good. second procurement thing: do we have a list of master agreements for the vendors in question? auditors often ask for contract vs invoice mapping.
[15:45] Sam: yes i have a contract index; i'll link it in the evidence bundle.
[15:55] Riley: on the security proof side—i will include change ticket IDs, KMS event ids, and HSM signature headers where available. sometimes HSM signatures are binary blobs that auditors can't read; i'll produce a signed digest and explain how to verify.
[16:20] Devon: will auditors require raw KV cache dump? (laughter)
[16:28] Ava: no, we shouldn't hand over any KV cache. (smiles) focus on config and rotation metadata.
[16:40] Maya: and redact any customer prompt or output if present in logs.
[16:50] Riley: done. i'll grep and redact PII.
[17:05] Ava: let's talk about naming conventions for uploaded artifacts so index parsing script works. use prefix: 2027Q3_audit/<artifact-type>/<fiscal_q>_<po_or_ticket>_<shortdesc>.pdf
[17:30] Devon: that's fine. i'll adjust the CSV exporter to generate matching names.
[17:42] Noah: quick ops note: when creating presigned urls, set expire to 30 days but also include a sha256 checksum in index.
[17:55] Ava: good call.
[18:10] [00:18:10] Sam: procurement question — sometimes vendors email receipts that have different vendor names than the PO; how do we want to record alias names?
[18:30] Devon: add vendor_alias column and include original email header as attachment if possible.
[18:45] Maya: legal says keep original headers for chain of custody.
[18:55] Riley: I'll make a note in the digest.
[19:10] Ava: next, outstanding compliance artifact—SOC 2 evidence request 47 asked for KMS rotation logs with operator identity. do we have that covered?
[19:30] Riley: yes, the operator field is present in the rotation audit event but sometimes it's "system" for automated runs; i'll annotate which ones were automated and which had human operator.
[19:50] Devon: can we flag automated runs in the CSV?
[19:58] Riley: yes, add a boolean automated_run column.
[20:10] Ava: okay timeline recap — Devon does invoice CSV by 9/16, Ava evidence bundle draft 9/17, Riley logs 9/18, Sam procurement receipts 9/20, Maya legal review 9/21. everyone agree?
[20:30] [Speaker 2]: agree.
[20:36] Noah: quick tech note — I found two legacy logs with different timezone stamps (PST vs UTC); i'll normalize timestamps to UTC in the export and note original tz in metadata.
[20:55] Ava: excellent.
[21:10] Devon: minor item — for the amortization schedule, CFO wants a per-month run rate; i'll include that.
[21:25] Maya: include any contract amendments as separate attachments.
[21:40] Ava: one risk to call out — if we can't find vendor receipt for PO-3410, auditors might request vendor confirmation letter. Sam, be ready to request that.
[21:58] Sam: noted.
[22:10] [00:22:10] Riley: random transcribe miss earlier — it said K-V cache when i said KV cache, so ignore phonetic glitch.
[22:25] Ava: thanks. aside from the timeline, any blockers?
[22:35] Devon: nothing major, just man-hours. i may need a couple hours from ops for matching logs.
[22:48] Noah: i can allocate two hours Wednesday.
[23:00] Ava: great. let's confirm folders: compliance S3 prefix will be s3://redwood-compliance/2027Q3-audit; we'll create a /working subfolder and /final. working gets write perms for owners only.
[23:25] Sam: will we put contracts in /final only?
[23:30] Ava: yes final for contracts and signed artifacts. working for drafts and exports.
[23:45] Devon: small FYI — there's an automated billing augmentation script that runs monthly on the 5th, it sometimes reclassifies credits; i'll snapshot previous month before we finalize.
[24:05] Riley: good call, snapshot and hash it.
[24:20] Ava: ok we'll wrap up with a quick recap.
[24:30] [00:24:30] Recap by Ava: Devon — invoice CSV and tagging by 9/16. Riley — KMS and Okta logs export by 9/18 plus annotated digest. Sam — procurement receipts and PO chase by 9/20. Maya — legal review/redactions by 9/21. Ava — assemble index.md and upload to compliance bucket and produce presigned zip by 9/17. Noah — normalize timestamps and produce concurrency vs cost snapshot.
[25:05] Maya: i'll review the bundle and flag redaction items.
[25:15] Sam: will escalate vendor receipts if not received.
[25:25] Devon: will attach amortization schedule and contract excerpt.
[25:40] [00:25:40] Ava: any final questions?
[25:50] Devon: none from me.
[26:00] Riley: none.
[26:10] Noah: all set.
[26:20] Ava: ok meeting adjourned, i'll post notes and the link. thanks everyone.
[26:35] [00:26:35] End meeting notes: call lasted 58 minutes per recording; some small gaps due to note-taking and screen-sharing.
